name: ScrollBaselineProvider.output_preserves_clamped_physical_baseline

  exact orientation_is_involutive first outer _

name: ScrollBaselineProvider.result_is_within_border_box

theorem result_is_within_border_box (first : Bool) (outer inner border distance : Int)

      repaired first outer inner border distance ≤ outer := by
  have h := clamp_bounds outer (border + fromStart first inner distance) valid
  cases first <;> simp only [repaired,fromStart,ite_true,Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false] at * <;> omega

name: ScrollBaselineProvider.last_group_interior_conversion

theorem last_group_interior_conversion (outer inner border distance : Int)
    (lower : 0 ≤ border + inner - distance)
    (upper : border + inner - distance ≤ outer) :
    repaired false outer inner border distance = outer - border - inner + distance := by
  unfold repaired fromStart clamp
  simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false]
  omega

name: ScrollBaselineProvider.asymmetric_border_error
complete_declaration:
theorem asymmetric_border_error (outer inner start finish distance : Int)
    (sizes : outer = start + inner + finish)
    (oldLower : 0 ≤ start + distance) (oldUpper : start + distance ≤ outer)
    (newLower : 0 ≤ start + inner - distance)
    (newUpper : start + inner - distance ≤ outer) :
    original outer start distance - repaired false outer inner start distance = start - finish := by
  have h := last_group_interior_conversion outer inner start distance newLower newUpper
  unfold original clamp
  omega

name: ScrollBaselineProvider.symmetric_borders_are_an_interior_control
complete_declaration:
theorem symmetric_borders_are_an_interior_control (outer inner border distance : Int)
    (sizes : outer = border + inner + border)
    (oldLower : 0 ≤ border + distance) (oldUpper : border + distance ≤ outer)
    (newLower : 0 ≤ border + inner - distance)
    (newUpper : border + inner - distance ≤ outer) :
    original outer border distance = repaired false outer inner border distance := by
  have h := asymmetric_border_error outer inner border border distance sizes
    oldLower oldUpper newLower newUpper
  omega

    (valid : 0 ≤ outer ∧ outer ≤ 2147483647) :

    clamp outer (border + fromStart first inner distance) ≤ 2147483647 ∧

name: ScrollBaselineDispatch.continuation_value
complete_declaration:
theorem continuation_value (i : Input) (p : List Event) :
    (continuation i p).value =
      if i.contain then none else i.child.map (repaired i.first i.outer i.inner i.border) := by
  cases h : i.contain <;> cases f : i.first <;> cases d : i.child <;>
    simp [continuation, h, f, d, repaired, fromStart, clamp]

name: ScrollBaselineDispatch.native_value_split
complete_declaration:
theorem native_value_split (i : Input) :
    (native i).value = if legacy i then some i.fallback else
      if i.contain then none else i.child.map (repaired i.first i.outer i.inner i.border) := by
  rcases i with ⟨f,l,b,t,c,o,n,s,v,d⟩
  cases f <;> cases l <;> cases b <;> cases t <;> cases c <;> cases d <;> rfl

name: ScrollBaselineDispatch.full_value_refinement
complete_declaration:
theorem full_value_refinement (i : Input) (size : 0 ≤ i.outer) :
    (native i).value = reference i := by
  rw [native_value_split]
  unfold reference route
  split
  · rfl
  · split
    · rfl
    · cases h : i.child with
      | none => simp
      | some d =>
        simp only [Option.isSome_some, ↓reduceIte, Option.map_some]
        have same := clamp_matches_independent_piecewise i d size
        unfold repaired
        rw [same]
        rfl

name: ScrollBaselineDispatch.synthesis_precedes_containment
complete_declaration:
theorem synthesis_precedes_containment (i : Input) (yes : legacy i = true) :
    native i = ⟨some i.fallback, [.queryBlock, .queryButton, .fallback]⟩ := by
  have value := native_value_split i
  have calls := exact_ordered_calls i
  simp only [yes, ↓reduceIte] at value
  simp [expectedCalls, route, yes] at calls
  cases h : native i
  simp_all

name: ScrollBaselineDispatch.all_candidate_operations_fit
complete_declaration:
theorem all_candidate_operations_fit (i : Input) (d : Int)
    (outer : 0 ≤ i.outer ∧ i.outer ≤ 2147483647)
    (inner : 0 ≤ i.inner ∧ i.inner ≤ 2147483647)
    (border : -2147483648 ≤ i.border ∧ i.border ≤ 2147483647)
    (distance : -2147483648 ≤ d ∧ d ≤ 2147483647) :
    -9223372036854775808 ≤ fromStart i.first i.inner d ∧
    fromStart i.first i.inner d ≤ 9223372036854775807 ∧
    -9223372036854775808 ≤ i.border + fromStart i.first i.inner d ∧
    i.border + fromStart i.first i.inner d ≤ 9223372036854775807 ∧
    0 ≤ clamp i.outer (i.border + fromStart i.first i.inner d) ∧
    clamp i.outer (i.border + fromStart i.first i.inner d) ≤ 2147483647 ∧
    0 ≤ repaired i.first i.outer i.inner i.border d ∧
    repaired i.first i.outer i.inner i.border d ≤ 2147483647 := by
